description: 한국철도공사_화물 수송실적 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사가 제공하는 ‘연도별 건설 수송실적(톤수)’ 자료로, 연도별로 유류, 장비 등 건설 관련 화물이 철도를 통해 실제로 수송된 총 실적(톤수)을 집계한 파일입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 선별, 화물, 수송실적, 2024년, 화물 톤수. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
